title: 10Aug-Sri Lanka–India Trade Invest Promotional Eve
summary: On 10 August our Club co-hosted and participated in Sri Lanka – India Trade & Investment Promotional Event at Bombay Chamber of Commerce, Dadar in the presence of Ms Priyanga Wickramasinghem Consul General of Sri Lanka.
description:
On 10 August our Club co-hosted and participated in Sri Lanka – India Trade & Investment Promotional Event at Bombay Chamber of Commerce, Dadar in the presence of Ms Priyanga Wickramasinghem Consul General of Sri Lanka. Led by Mr Mangala Wijesinghe, Chairman & CEO Sri Lanka Export Development Board.
The program included welcome remarks by Mr Viraj Kulkarni, Remarks by Consul General of Sri Lanka, short video on Sri Lanka, Presentation by Chairman, Export Develop Board of Sri Lanka, Video on Sri Lanka Expo, Presentation on Gem & Jewellery Industry of Sri Lanka by the National Gem and Jewellery Authority, short video on Sapphire Sri Lanka, Intro of Sri Lankan Gem Exporters followed by Networking and Lunch
Srilanka’s blue sapphires and rubies are globally famous and since there will be 11 jewellers we had super access.
Our thanks to Rtn Viraj Kulkarni, Hon. Consul of Cyprus & Chairman, International Trade & Commerce Committee of Bombay Chamber for invitation. Attended by 7 Pierites.
